description: Applied import tariffs from the World Bank WITS / UNCTAD TRAINS database for one importing country and one HS 6-digit product: yearly simple-average rate (%), tariff type (MFN or preferential), min and max line rates and number of tariff lines, from WITS's public SDMX API. Partner defaults to the world (MFN). Non-tariff measures are not included. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

partner.description: Exporting partner, ISO alpha-3 or numeric (default 000 = world)

reporter.description: Importing country, ISO alpha-3 (e.g. TUR, USA) or WITS numeric code (e.g. 792) (required)

years.description: Most recent years to return, 1 to 15 (default 5)

name: energy_world_customs_tariff_wits
title: Energy World Customs Tariff Wits
